messages:
jen: SRE reported confusion: they flipped 'Auto fallback' and expected an immediate full switchover but traffic continued to primary. No readable audit line in console. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1723
akash: Do we have structured policy-change events? we emit JSON but the UI only shows "ON/OFF".
maria: Right. The ask is a compact human-friendly audit entry when policy changes: who, env, mode, sample, triggers. SRE needs that to triage.
sam: UX fix: add a summary pill beside toggle: "Auto fallback — silent · sample=1% · triggers: latency, 5xx" with an edit chevron. Also tooltip explaining modes.
akash: Backend note: policy stored as JSON already, example: { policy_id: "pf-8a3", enabled: true, mode: "silent", sample_pct: 1, triggers: ["latency_over_1s", "5xx_rate>2%"] } I'll add a compact audit emission on the policy update endpoint including user email and req_id. ops-bot: Dev event created: evt-8234 -> emits compact policy-change records.
maria: Also add a small "Why did I fallback?" link on rollout results that opens aggregated sampled decisions (counts + top reasons) rather than full request logs. SRE just wants quick explanations.
jen: Scope this as P2 but quick patch requested: 1) pill UI, 2) audit entry with mode/sample/triggers. Can we get a dev-preview by Thu?
sam: I can ship the pill and acceptance test asserting pill text and tooltip.
akash: I'll add audit emission and tests to ensure event contains mode + sample + triggers and plumb to event-log stream. Will update OpenAPI spec accordingly.
maria: I'll post microcopy variations in #design in 45m. Suggested pill copy: "Auto fallback — silent (no user-visible fallback) · sample=1% · triggers: latency, 5xx"
jen: Nice. Acceptance test for INF-1723: after POST /policies/update the UI should show audit line: "Auto fallback ENABLED (silent, sample=1%, triggers=[latency_over_1s, 5xx_rate>2%]) by jen@redwood".
akash: PR will be linked to INF-1723. ops-bot: reminder: decision logs remain sampled at 0.1% for now; aggregated view will read from that sampling.
jen: Great. Revisit broader fallback UX later (visibility into sampled decisions, export to incidents). For now small patch. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
